name: Write long-form fictional narratives
description: Users asked the AI to write substantial, multi-chapter, or long-form fictional narratives across diverse genres such as science fiction, fantasy, and historical fiction. These requests often involved developing complex character arcs, world-building, specific plot twists, or extended dialogues, frequently based on user-provided premises, existing fictional universes, or hypothetical scenarios.
